topic: The batsman who scored a century on debut and was never picked again
hook: He scored 100 on debut and was never seen again.
script: He scored 100 on debut and was never seen again. Ian Craig hit a century for Australia at just 17. The selectors called him a future legend. Then they dropped him. He was picked again years later but never recaptured the magic. One perfect debut. One century. Then silence. Follow for cricket stories that break your heart.
